sources.snippet: Muse Glimmer 30B - W4A16 AutoRound / GPTQ This repository contains the W4A16 quantized versions of Meta's Muse Glimmer 30B, optimized for efficient local inference. The model was quantized using Intel AutoRound to 4-bit precision while explicitly keeping the Vision Encoder in its original precision (BF16) to preserve multimodal and visual agentic capabilities without degradation.
